##


Forsaken Characters and Forsaken OC Ideas


#


**[Forsaken](https://www.roblox.com/games/18687417158/Forsaken)** is a popular multiplayer survival horror game on Roblox: eight Survivors try to escape one Killer before The Spectre’s world catches them. Its lore and a massive cast inspired by[Roblox’s internet mythology](https://mythcommunity.fandom.com/wiki/Roblox%27s_Myths) , like Guest 1337 or 1x1x1x1, plus dark arcs, have kept the fandom building their own versions of these characters instead of just playing them in-game.


The game’s nostalgic character concepts, creative storytelling and asymmetrical mechanics have kept fans engaged, building a lively subculture of artists and writers who create fan art, explore lore theories and showcase their unique Forsaken OC ideas – their own *Survivor* or *Killer* characters – on social platforms like TikTok and Reddit.


*The game turns Roblox internet mythology, hackers and old legends like Guest 1337, Shedletsky, and 1x1x1x1, into Survivors and Killers with real backstories*


###


Survivors


#


[Survivors](https://forsaken2024.fandom.com/wiki/Survivors) work as a team to finish objectives and escape before the[Killer](https://forsaken2024.fandom.com/wiki/Killers) catches them, each with a distinct ability set.


**Veeronica** is a rebellious robot with a magenta TV for a head, a spray can, and a skateboard. She’s one of two surviving prototypes from an experimental “Helper RO-Bots” program meant to guide Robloxians before it was scrapped. Her unique playstyle and bittersweet lore make her a massive favorite for fan content and[Forsaken Veeronica OC](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/veeronica-tkayllmz7wde) ideas.


*by f8fjf86b54_ezp4*


*by eluneysilva51_fefa*


**Guest 1337** is a battle-scarred soldier from The Last Guest, a fan movie about the last guest on Roblox fighting a genocidal empire. His number itself is leetspeak for “elite.” His protector role and tragic backstory make him a favorite for[Forsaken Guest 1337 OC](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/guest-1337-bbtplh1m2ye7) concepts built around loyalty and sacrifice.


**[Shedletsky](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/shedletsky-jr2i7u8l8j6t)** is a free starter Survivor based on Roblox’s real former Creative Director. He’s reimagined as a retired admin who fights with a Linked Sword and heals with fried chicken. His humor hides a darker history: he’s the reason 1x1x1x1 exists.


*by al9466572_1rua*


*by ethan*


**[Two Time](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/two-time-bnb8pjq757is)** is a member of the Spawn Cult who murdered their closest friend, Azure, chasing a second life. That act now lets him respawn once per round and is the fandom’s most retold piece of Forsaken lore.


The rest of the roster includes:[007n7](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/007n7-lxp6mre2po5x) ,[Chance](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/chance-uwral9gyufh3) ,[Dusekkar](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/dusekkars-rl1myp5pa1p0) ,[Elliot](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/elliot-builder-uk3rjgo01kjw) ,[Builderman](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/builderman-jir1tyssf18q) ,[Noob](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/noob-2007-45iwnwoi4mw2) , and Taph.


###


Killers


#


Killers hunt Survivors with a Malice Meter and abilities built to control the map.


**[Azure](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/azure-e9was6r66bwj)** is the payoff to Two Time’s story. After being murdered, The Spectre drags Aspen back as Azure, also called[Azurewrath](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/azurewrath-ikwl4ba89w61) , a plant-controlling monster tied to the cult that killed him.


*by bobertinvalidcarltop_7ai7*


*by deanrodg5_qmki*


[c00lkidd](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/c00lkidd-jece3zgyp7i7) is a red, fleshy Robloxian based on a real early-2010s Roblox hacking group. Fellow Survivor 007n7 raised him after he was left on his doorstep. Now a free starter Killer, his minions and map vandalism echo that group’s real exploits.


**[1x1x1x1](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/1x1x1x1-du0krwvs5dty)** is a black, glitching entity with twin blades, based on Roblox’s oldest urban legend – a hacker who despises the third dimension. In Forsaken’s lore, he’s literally the hatred Shedletsky tore out of himself, which is why the two despise each other on sight.


*by triacorpsee_v1gp*


**[Guest 666](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/guest-666-pmaoauackqtm)** rounds out the lineup: a former Guest turned demonic beast after cheating to keep up with her only friend, Noob. The rest of the cast also includes[John Doe](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/john-doe-ndw45xpge7e1) , Noli,[Nosferatu](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/nosferatu-60kw10u6dglr) , and[Slasher](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/slasher-r3bl9lhcg65w) .

##


Forsaken OC Maker – How to Create Your Own Survivor or Killer Character


#


With your own Forsaken OC ideas inspired by the game, you can start creating a character by choosing a specific role, Survivor or Killer, then build out a visual concept, a piece of lore, and a special ability around it.


- For a Survivor, pair one active ability with one passive perk tied to a personality trait. For example, your own Forsaken Veeronica OC can be reckless and self-reliant, so she can skate around leaving graffiti that recharges her battery.
- Design a Killer concept: pick a signature weapon and one map-pressure ability that controls space instead of just dealing damage, the way Azure’s plants punish sound or 1x1x1x1’s ranged slash punishes distance. Either stick to a horror theme or change into any theme you love.
- When writing lore, borrow a real piece of Roblox legends or invent a new one. In-game characters like Shedletsky or Guest 1337 are actually based on real former Roblox myths. Another version of Elliot could be a soft-spoken, calm survivor who puts others before himself.


*Forsaken Characters and OCs recreated as pixel characters in Redbean*


###


Forsaken Character Maker Tools


#


You can buy cosmetics and skins, but you **can’t bring your own Forsaken OC into the official game** . When searching for a Forsaken character maker, players can explore **[Custom Forsaken Creator](https://www.roblox.com/games/92790970066273/Custom-Forsaken-Creator)** (on Roblox) or some Forsaken OC generator tools to design and customize their own characters and skins. Fan-made projects featuring custom character concepts and community writing can also be inspiration for your lore writing.


However, the experience is mostly built for desktop and doesn’t run well on phone, and none of these Forsaken character maker tools make it alive in a real game world, though. You can change how it looks and write its personality, but it still stops as a static image once you close the creator.


###


Build Your Own Forsaken Version with Redbean’s Forsaken OC Creator Tool


#


**[Redbean](https://www.redbean.ai/)** is a mobile sandbox (free-to-play on iOS & Android) for OC/fandom creators and roleplayers to **actually play with your OCs** , not a static character-image generator or another Forsaken OC Maker that only hands you a look. With Redbean’s Forsaken character maker tool, you can build your own Survivor OC, Killer OC, pixel version of Guest 1337 or Azure, define their personas, lore and any kind of relationships, then **bring them to life in a living Forsaken-inspired town** shaped entirely by you.


What you can do with Redbean:


- [Create your character from a photo/image or a sketch](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/ai-anime-oc-maker-create-your-first-original-character) , or draw from scratch. Turn your imagination into a playable pixel character that can move, talk, and react.
- **Write their persona and lore** : Recreate Veeronica as she plays in-game, give Guest 1337 a new backstory, or build your own Survivor. Add them as NPCs who remember what you tell them and react as who you wrote them to be.
- **Set character connections** : build your own version of the Two Time and Azure dynamic, or a rivalry nobody’s written yet.
- **Shape your own town** : Describe a Forsaken-style setting in a few words and Redbean puts a pixel version together for you to walk around in. Design your own world in any theme you love and write anything that could happen in it: from a horror, haunted town to a peaceful beach or medieval market.
- Your characters and NPCs keep living when you’re not directing them: they wander around the town, meet and interact with each other. **Build a Forsaken AU from your imagination** : your Veeronica, Two Time, or Noob can share a town with[Ratthew from Animal Hospital](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/animal-hospital-art-challenge-with-oc#Step-by-step_to_create_a_playable_OC_in_Redbean_inspired_by_Animal_Hospital) , Pomni from TADC, or any character you love.
- **[Explore other players’ towns](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/redbean-challenge-the-ocs-hangout)** and characters through the Explore tab. Or make your own town public so other players can visit and play with your unique world.

How to make a Forsaken survivor or killer OC in a Forsaken OC maker tool?


#


Start with a role, Survivor or Killer, and a rough look, then borrow what makes a canon character work: Veeronica pairs a reckless personality with an ability that fits it, while Azure’s plant control punishes anyone who stays still. Pick one defining trait, one signature ability, and a backstory beat inspired by the cast or others’ Forsaken OC ideas, then build it out in Redbean’s Forsaken character creation tool, where it becomes a character who can talk, react, and play out the scenarios you write for them.


###


How do I turn a Forsaken OC or fanart I already have into a character in Redbean?


#


Upload the fanart, sketch or reference image directly in Redbean’s Forsaken character creator, or draw from scratch in the in-app drawing tool, no art software or drawing skill required. Transform any photo of your OC or Forsaken characters into a playable pixel character you can name, give a persona and lore, define a speaking style for, and drop straight into your town.


###


Besides Forsaken OCs, can I make other characters in Redbean?

Yes. Redbean isn’t limited to one fandom, so the same mechanics work for any original character or a cast from a completely different universe – your Forsaken Veeronica OC can share a town with characters from other games like[Animal Hospital](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-roleplay) or series like[TADC](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/the-amazing-digital-circus-games-2026#Redbean_%E2%80%93_Amazing_Digital_Circus_Character_Creator_You_Can_Play_In) ,[The Walten Files](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/the-walten-files-oc-maker) .
